info.name: Get current time for the requester IP

items.docs: Returns the current time based on the public IP address of the requester, auto-detecting the caller's local timezone.

info.name: Get current time for a specific IP

params.name: ip
params.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to geolocate.

items.docs: Returns the current time resolved from a specific IPv4/IPv6 address.
